allowToolInstall.label: Install tools & MCP
allowToolInstall.description: Let the coworker npm-install packages and register MCP servers.

allowSoulEdit.label: Edit own soul
allowSoulEdit.description: Let the coworker rewrite its SOUL.md identity.

autoMemory.label: Auto-memory
autoMemory.description: Automatically curate memories after each turn.

filesystem.label: Read & write files
filesystem.blurb: Work with files in its workspace
filesystem.help: Lets the coworker open, create and edit files in its own workspace.

shell.label: Run commands
shell.help: Lets the coworker run terminal commands to install tools and automate tasks.

web.label: Browse the web
web.help: Lets the coworker search the internet and read web pages to find information.

memory.label: Remember things
memory.help: Lets the coworker store facts across runs and recall them later.

db.label: Access data
db.help: Lets the coworker read and write structured data in its own database.

brain.label: Use the company brain
brain.help: Lets the coworker search and read the Brain, the pages your team validated about the company, and propose changes you review before anything is saved.

sharedDb.label: Access shared data
sharedDb.help: Lets the coworker read and write the database every coworker of the workspace shares.

skills.label: Use skills
skills.help: Lets the coworker use the skills you've installed for specialized tasks.

self.label: Improve itself
self.help: Lets the coworker refine its own instructions and configuration over time.

schedule.label: Schedule tasks
schedule.help: Lets the coworker schedule tasks to run automatically at a chosen time.

trigger.label: React to webhooks
trigger.blurb: Run when another app calls it
trigger.help: Lets the coworker expose public URLs that start a run when an external service calls them.

callAgent.label: Work with other coworkers
callAgent.help: Lets the coworker hand off work to other coworkers of the workspace.

team.label: See other coworkers
team.help: Lets the coworker check the other coworkers of the workspace: their status, scheduled tasks, triggers and recent runs, with the tools each run called when it needs to understand a failure. It cannot change anything. A run can hold data from the other coworker's connected apps.

aiProviders.label: See its AI providers
aiProviders.blurb: Model in use, credit and quotas
aiProviders.help: Lets the coworker check which AI provider and model it runs on, the other providers connected to the workspace, and what is left on each: the Rerun credit and the limits of a Claude, Codex or OpenCode subscription. It cannot change anything.

askUser.label: Ask you questions
askUser.blurb: Pause to ask with answer options
askUser.help: Lets the coworker pause and ask you a question with answer options before continuing.

requestApproval.label: Request approval
requestApproval.help: Lets the coworker pause and ask you to approve or decline an action before it runs.

cards.label: Show cards in chat
cards.blurb: Preview a table or a file inline
cards.help: Lets the coworker drop a preview card in the conversation: the first rows of one of its tables, or a file from its workspace, that you can open in one click.

quickReplies.label: Suggest replies
quickReplies.help: Lets the coworker end a message with up to three short replies you can send in one click, such as "Find 100 more".

computer.label: Use its computer
computer.blurb: See and drive its own screen
computer.help: Lets the coworker look at its own desktop and click, type and scroll in its browser, its files and its terminal, for work that has to be done by hand in an app or a site. You can watch it live, and it pauses while you drive the screen yourself.

paidData.label: Leads, SEO & social data
paidData.help: Lets the coworker find prospects, their work emails and phone numbers and company data, check search volumes, keyword ideas and backlinks, read Google results and local businesses, and read public profiles and posts on LinkedIn, TikTok, Instagram, X, YouTube, Facebook and Reddit, without an Apollo, Semrush or scraping subscription. Each call is paid from your Rerun credits, and the coworker asks you to approve an estimated cost first.

requestSecret.label: Ask for a credential
requestSecret.blurb: Pause for a key, entered securely
requestSecret.help: Lets the coworker pause and ask you for an API key or token in a masked form. The value is stored as a coworker variable and never enters the conversation.

paidDataAlwaysAllow.label: Spend without asking
paidDataAlwaysAllow.description: Skip the cost approval, so scheduled runs and delegated tasks can use paid data while you are away.
